goal: Prevent node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by chainstate compaction exhausting filesystem disk space
Skip compaction when free space is low and log compaction progress by default for node operators
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, stickies-v)
Author adopted suggestion to skip compaction instead of only warning (andrewtoth)
Open suggestion to compact ranges in slices rather than all at once (stickies-v)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it fixes node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by background compaction filling the disk
Prevents severe reliability failures for node operators running on limited storage
